ns2:section.sectionText: Online & Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Graduate students will be assessed $362 per credit hour; undergrad students will be assessed $325 per credit hour. All students will be assessed a $50 per credit hour administration fee. These assessments are in addition to the campus range assessments if students also take an on-campus class. Consult the course syllabus for further details. Students will need a working external microphone/speakers or headset with microphone and reliable high-speed Internet. Wireless Internet is not recommended. No class during the week of Thanksgiving break (November 22nd). This course is intended for FSHN degree students. CPSC, NRES and AGED degree and non-degree students should register in CPSC 440 XM (CRN: 50432).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: FSHN (Online) -UIUC, MS:FSci &Hmn Nutrition -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $362.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $325.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
